problems.title: default change contract fails its own scope reconciliation
problems.scope: Fixed Yunka existing-operation AX7 change begin/check workflow for delivery.items.update.
problems.consumer_workaround: Keep the contract outside the Git worktree and pass its exact path explicitly, or treat the default file as the sole known false-positive while retaining all canonical generation and check gates.
problems.verification: The default control file was the only reported out-of-contract path; all declared developer and generated paths were classified correctly; two generations and full canonical check passed; third_party/yunka remained unchanged.
